cases.name: Barbara Jane Senna Bisram
cases.about:
Bisram is described as a sweet, churchgoing woman and friendly neighbor who lost her husband months before her death “I think she was really lonesome,” (her sister Elain) Lynaugh said. “She was planning on moving to Vermont. She didn’t make it.” Lynaugh told us her sister’s suitcase was packed and her plane ticket bought when detectives discovered her body.

Her Find-A-Grave said, "Barbara worked tirelessly for many years as a licensed nurse's assistant and was a great friend to many. She loved taking care of people. Barbara loved planting flowers, working outside, crossstitching and crafts, as well as taking care of her birds.

Her favorite bird "Cookie" is going to miss her cheerful morning greeting."

cases.name: Heather Lee Grimshaw
cases.about: “My mom was a kind person that had a lot of love to offer,” said her daughter Alyson Grimshaw.
cases.narrative: On 8/29/2015, hikers found her skeletal remains in Picayune Strand State Forest.
